newsitem.title: CHINA: China conducts military landing exercise.
newsitem.headline: China conducts military landing exercise.

text.p: More than 10,000 Chinese soldiers took part in a landing exercise late last year, boosting their naval combat capability, the Liberation Army Daily said on Monday.
A division of the Guangzhou Military Region conducted the exercise, said the newspaper, the mouthpiece of the People's Liberation Army (PLA). It did not say where the exercise was held.
The exercise involved more than 10,000 soldiers and more than 1,000 vehicles, giving troops an "experience close to actual combat and increased their combat capability at sea", the newspaper said.
The newspaper ran a photograph of soldiers wading into the open hatch of a troop-carrying ship and another showing soldiers cleaning equipment.
China has denied it is a military threat to Asia or the rest of the world, but its build-up in recent years has caused anxiety among its neighbours.

The three million-strong PLA ruffled feathers last March when it sought to intimidate rival Taiwan by conducting missile tests and war games close to the island in the run-up to Taiwan's historic presidential elections.

China has been mired in a dispute with Japan over a group of islands in the East China Sea and involved in another dispute with several southeast Asian countries over the Spratly Islands in the South China Sea.
